step1_analysis.description: A purely passive resistor-capacitor network, likely serving as a matching network, filter, or bias tee in the 2.4 GHz RF front-end. It contains no active devices.

paper_reference.title: A 2.4-GHz-Band 1.8-V Operation Single-Chip Si-CMOS T/R-MMIC Front-End with a Low Insertion Loss Switch

insertion_loss_2_4GHz.description: Insertion loss (S21) of the passive network at the operating frequency of 2.4 GHz.

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends entirely on the passive component values. Assuming typical RF matching values (e.g., 1pF, 50 ohms), it will exhibit moderate loss.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Passive networks inherently introduce some insertion loss, especially if not perfectly matched to 50 ohms.

return_loss_2_4GHz.description: Return loss (S11) at the input port at 2.4 GHz.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the input impedance Zin relative to 50 ohms. S11 = 20*log10(|(Zin-50)/(Zin+50)|).
sky130_expected.reasoning: A well-designed RF matching network aims for a return loss better than -10 dB.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the S-parameters (S21 Insertion Loss and S11 Return Loss) of the passive network at 2.4 GHz using a 50-ohm source and load.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Passive RC Network Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameterized passive values (defaults provided for simulation)
.param c1_val=1p c2_val=1p c3_val=1p r1_val=50 r2_val=50 r3_val=50 r4_val=50

* DUT
C1 n0 n3 {c1_val}
C2 n0 label_net_0 {c2_val}
C3 n1 n2 {c3_val}
R1 n3 0 {r1_val}
R2 n0 n1 {r2_val}
R3 n3 0 {r3_val}
R4 n2 0 {r4_val}

* DC Bias
VLABEL_NET_0 label_net_0 0 0.9

* AC Source and Load (50 ohm system)
* Vac=2V with 50 ohm source and 50 ohm load gives 0dB (1V) at load if perfectly matched/lossless
Vac n0_src 0 dc 0 ac 2
Rsrc n0_src n0 50
Rload n1 0 50

.control
ac dec 100 100M 10G

* Calculate S21 (Insertion Loss)
let s21_db = vdb(n1)

* Calculate S11 (Return Loss)
* V(n0) = Vsrc * Zin / (Zin + 50) = 2 * Zin / (Zin + 50)
* S11 = (Zin - 50) / (Zin + 50) = V(n0) - 1
let s11_vec = v(n0) - 1
let s11_mag = mag(s11_vec)
let s11_db = 20 * log10(s11_mag + 1e-12)

* Measure at 2.4 GHz
meas ac s21_2_4G find s21_db at=2.4G
meas ac s11_2_4G find s11_db at=2.4G

print s21_2_4G s11_2_4G
quit
.endc
.end
